## Study: the-granary

The Granary T8 preregistered readout: do raids land on the hunger side of the year? Two aggregate per-world metrics over 1,000 default-pin worlds (seeds 0-999): the circular concentration of raid-ending day-of-year stamps, and the fraction falling in the depleted half of each victim site's authored harvest curve. Hypothesis (frozen before this study ran): raids cluster on the hunger side.

Seeds 0..1000 × 1 pin set(s); 1000 rows; 0 refusals.
